subject.title: feat(worktrees): configurable cleanup limits (max count, max total size) with Settings UI

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt two new worktree cleanup configuration keys that can automatically evict younger session- and Workboard-owned worktrees to enforce count and disk-size limits?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but the repository sets a high bar for new configuration and fallback/retention policy; accepting automatic early eviction and a permanent Settings surface requires maintainer intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Sponsor with live proof
options.body: Approve the opt-in core configuration direction, then require a clean rebase and real Gateway eviction-and-restore proof before merge.

options.title: Keep current retention policy
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and retain seven-day idle cleanup plus explicit manual removal until a different product-level disk-management design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with live proof
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in core configuration direction, then require a clean rebase and real Gateway eviction-and-restore proof before merge.
